title: prisma migrate deploy
description: Safely execute pending migrations in staging, production, and CI/CD automated pipelines without prompts or shadow databases.

data.text: In production, staging, and automated CI/CD runners, you must NEVER run `prisma migrate dev` because it requires interactive prompts and a shadow database. Instead, you run **`prisma migrate deploy`**.

rows: Yes (warns on data loss, asks for confirmation)
Fails immediately with an error if schema drifted
Does not run generate (run `prisma generate` separately)

data.text: Integrating with GitHub Actions or Docker

data.title: Dockerfile / Entrypoint Production Pattern
data.content: Running migration deploy prior to launching the production web server.
data.code:
#!/bin/sh
set -e

echo "Running production database migrations..."
npx prisma migrate deploy

echo "Starting Next.js Server..."
exec node server.js

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: `prisma migrate deploy` applies all unapplied migration files in chronological order.
It never prompts for input and never resets the database.
Always run `prisma migrate deploy` as part of your deployment build or release phase.
